parameters.name: ClientUniqueCode
parameters.description: The client unique code of the workflow, used for asynchronous operations and idempotence. If not specified during creation, the system automatically generates one, and the code is uniquely bound to the resource ID. If this parameter is specified during update or deletion, it must be consistent with the client unique code used during creation.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The dependency type. Valid values:
- CrossCycleDependsOnChildren: cross-cycle dependency on first-level child nodes
- CrossCycleDependsOnSelf: cross-cycle dependency on the current node
- CrossCycleDependsOnOtherNode: cross-cycle dependency on other nodes
- Normal: same-cycle dependency

sub_parameters.name: UpstreamOutput
sub_parameters.description: The output identifier of the upstream node. This field is returned when the dependency type is `same-cycle dependency` and input content is specified.

sub_parameters.name: UpstreamTaskId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the upstream node. This field is returned when the dependency type is `cross-cycle dependency on other nodes` or `same-cycle dependency` without input content specified. It is not returned in other cases.

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description:
The project environment. Valid values:
- Prod: production
- Dev: development

parameters.name: InstanceMode
parameters.description:
The instance generation mode. Valid values:

- T+1: Instances are generated the next day.
- Immediately: Instances are generated immediately. Periodic instances are generated only if the scheduled time of the workflow is at least 10 minutes after the workflow is published. During the full instance generation period (22:00 to 24:00), real-time instance generation is not available. You can submit and publish workflows during this period, but instances are not regenerated after submission.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The account ID of the owner.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value.

sub_parameters.name: BaseLineId
sub_parameters.description: The baseline ID.

sub_parameters.name: ClientUniqueCode
sub_parameters.description: The client unique code of the node, used for asynchronous operations and idempotence. If not specified during creation, the system automatically generates one, and the code is uniquely bound to the resource ID. If this parameter is specified during update or deletion, it must be consistent with the client unique code used during creation.

sub_parameters.name: DataSource
sub_parameters.description: The associated data source information.

sub_parameters.name: Dependencies
sub_parameters.description: The dependency information. If this field is not specified or is an empty array, all Dependencies configurations are deleted by default.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description.

sub_parameters.name: EnvType
sub_parameters.description:
The project environment. Valid values:
- Prod: production
- Dev: development

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The node ID. If this field is specified, the corresponding node is fully updated. If this field is not specified, a new node is created.

sub_parameters.name: Inputs
sub_parameters.description: The input information. If this field is empty, all Inputs configurations are deleted by default.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the node.

sub_parameters.name: Outputs
sub_parameters.description: The output information. If this field is empty, all Outputs configurations are deleted by default.

sub_parameters.name: Owner
sub_parameters.description: The account ID of the owner.

sub_parameters.name: RerunInterval
sub_parameters.description: The retry time interval, in seconds.

sub_parameters.name: RerunMode
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node can be rerun. Valid values:
- AllDenied: cannot be rerun regardless of success or failure
- FailureAllowed: can be rerun only upon failure
- AllAllowed: can be rerun regardless of success or failure

sub_parameters.name: RerunTimes
sub_parameters.description: The number of retries. This parameter takes effect only when the node is configured to allow reruns.

sub_parameters.name: RuntimeResource
sub_parameters.description: The runtime environment configuration, such as resource group information.

sub_parameters.name: Script
sub_parameters.description: The script information.

sub_parameters.name: Tags
sub_parameters.description: The list of node tags. If this field is not specified or is an empty array, all Tags configurations are deleted by default.

sub_parameters.name: Timeout
sub_parameters.description: The timeout period for node execution, in seconds.

sub_parameters.name: Trigger
sub_parameters.description: The trigger configuration of the node.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description: The node type.
